name: Bamboo-tube soup
summary: Lá nhíp, rattan shoots, bitter eggplant, and stream fish packed into a bamboo tube with spring water and roasted over charcoal.
origin: A highland soup of the Jrai, Ba Na, Xơ Đăng, and Ê Đê, cooked around Kon Tum.
howToEat: The tube is roasted over charcoal and the soup is poured out of it.
seoTitle: Bamboo-tube soup around Kon Tum — canh thut
seoDescription: Lá nhíp, rattan shoots, bitter eggplant, and stream fish roasted in a bamboo tube over charcoal.
